title: Malaysian Beef Stir Fry
description: Quick and easy Malaysian-inspired beef stir fry made with aromatic spices, crisp vegetables, and flavorful noodles. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat aromatic oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove beef from skillet and set aside.
Add onion and crisp vegetables to skillet and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add noodles to skillet and stir to combine with vegetables.
Return beef to skillet and stir in soy sauce and chili flakes.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until sauce is bubbly.
Stir in garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Optional: garnish with green onions or sesame seeds.
